podcasts.name: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Madonna's First Band Name
podcast.body: The band's name, Emmy and the Emmys, used "Emmy" as a shortened form of the letter "M," which itself was short for Madonna. "In this case, Emmy stood for the letter M. And M was short for Madonna."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Madonna's Post-Punk Attempt
podcast.body: Emmy and the Emmys was Madonna's initial effort to lead a post-punk band, which ultimately "didn't work" before she achieved global fame within four years. "Emmy and the Emmys was her first attempt at leading a post-punk band."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: First Post-Punk Attempt
xref.body: Madonna's first attempt at leading a post-punk band was Emmy and the Emmys, formed in 1980. This project did not work out, but within four years, she achieved global fame. "Emmy and the Emmys was her first attempt at leading a post-punk band."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
